messages:
maya: Heads-up — seeing a p95 token-level latency spike on the canary (model=v1.3-quant) for /generate. Opening thread with traces and dashboard links.
perf-bot: ALERT 1763301123 — per_token_latency_p95 increased 38% vs control for model=v1.3-quant on route=/generate. Canary traffic 4%.
sam: Yep I can reproduce on Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rtk1x/token-latency?var-model=v1.3-quant. Token breakdown shows attention kernel time doubling around seq_len > 512.
jin: Possible kernel-selection fallback when KV cache grows. I uploaded a profiler summary to the artifacts bucket. Quick excerpt:
```
Profiler summary (torch):
- attention_forward: 62% time (matmul_generic fallback)
- kv_cache_write: 8%
- cuda_memcpy: 5%
- matmul_fused: 18% (was 45% in baseline)
```
alex: Did we change the kernel selector heuristics yesterday? I pushed an alignment tweak to tensor-width thresholds in selector service at 02:14 UTC.
nora: Canary note — canary allocation is 4% traffic and mostly long-context test users from the eval suite. A/B dashboard shows regression only on long-context synthetic load, control is stable.
sam: We also changed the dynamic-batching window from 8ms -> 12ms last week which ups avg batch size but could hurt tail for small seqmsgs. Replay harness might show the interplay.
maya: I ran the replay across three seq buckets (1-64, 65-512, >512) — summary: p50/p95 for >512 bucket increased: p50 +8ms, p95 +85ms. Small sequences unaffected.
jin: The profiler trace pinpoints a fallback at step 72 where selector chose `matmul_generic` for a 2048x512 activation due to alignment mismatch. nvprof capture:
```
Device Kernel Time
matmul_generic 134.2ms
matmul_fused 48.6ms
```
alex: Rolling back my selector alignment change in a local build fixed p95 by ~30% on the >512 replay. Likely regression introduced by the alignment threshold widening. :thumbsup:
nora: We should also add KV-cache hit-rate per-request to model-version comparison dashboard. Low KV hit-rate correlates with extra matmul cost and higher token latencies in replayed sessions.
sam: Agreed — add panel: `kv_cache_hit_ratio{model,route,version}` and a per-route p95 delta. Also tag traces with `kv_hit=true/false` to make trace sampling easier.
maya: Action items: 1) Revert selector alignment change (alex) — high priority. 2) Add KV hit-rate metric + dashboard panel (nora) — medium. 3) Add alert: token-level p95 delta >10% vs control on any canary for >5 minutes (maya). I'll own the alert.
alex: Opening revert PR now, will link.
deploy-bot: Canary 17 (model=v1.3-quant) roll forward paused; configuration change detected and rollback initiated per policy.
maya: After revert we'll run a controlled canary replay and update the model-version comparison dashboard so PMs can see per-route KPIs (p50/p95/p99, per-token decomposition, kv_hit%).
jin: For the dashboard panels, recommend adding a stacked breakdown: compute:matmul, compute:attention, io:kv_lookup, memcpy. That makes regressions actionable.
nora: I'll draft a Grafana PR with per-route panels and a comparison row for canary vs control. Expect it by EOD.
sam: Also add an automated nightly profiling job for long-context tails to catch regressions earlier.
maya: Cool — let's triage on this thread once the revert PR lands and the canary replay completes. Thanks everyone.
